data.name: Steal Anime Eggs
data.description:
🥚 Welcome to Steal Anime Eggs ! 

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from Anime
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare anime
💰 Earn money from your anime
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, anime, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
